description: Hello, we are team Orb of Night!
summary: Created by "Orb Of Night" for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, Orb of Night turns space hardware left on the Moon into an interactive learning adventure. Exploring the Moon via a Mission Time Machine (1950s–2020s), users can locate abandoned rovers, landers, and equipment using exact planetary coordinates and read engaging micro-stories about each artifact—sparking cosmic curiosity while advocating for planetary protection.
details:
Orb of Night: The Ultimate Lunar Scavenger Hunt

Crafted by Team Techna for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, Orb of Night transforms over six decades of lunar exploration into an exhilarating digital treasure hunt for young space enthusiasts. Instead of burying students under dry spreadsheets, our interactive web portal turns human-made hardware resting on the Moon into an engaging, story-driven expedition.

How It Works: Navigating the Crater Trail

At the heart of the platform lies the Crater Trail, a dynamic portal featuring an interactive 3D World View and a Mission Time Machine dashboard spanning the 1960s through the 2020s. By hopping across decades, curious minds can click location pins across the lunar globe to inspect abandoned Apollo landers, lunar buggies, and historic probes. Each artifact slot unlocks two vital pieces of discovery:

Exact Cartographic Coordinates: Precision latitude, longitude, and elevation benchmarks derived directly from NASA NSSDCA and LROC orbital telemetry.

Captivating Micro-Stories: Bite-sized, imaginative tales illuminating each machine’s high-stakes mission, scientific triumphs, and ultimate resting place.

Tech, Creativity, and Impact

Built with a clean web foundation of HTML, CSS, and Node.js, and featuring a custom-rendered 3D Moon modeled in Blender, Orb of Night bridges complex space agency datasets with vibrant, intuitive design. We tailored the experience specifically for school-age kids—replacing academic jargon with glowing visual controls, gamified narrative hooks, and strict cartographic accuracy.

Beyond sparking scientific curiosity, the project delivers a vital message of planetary protection. By showcasing the quiet artifacts scattered across lunar craters, Orb of Night reminds future astronauts and engineers that space is a shared sanctuary—inspiring them to explore boldly while safeguarding pristine extraterrestrial environments for generations to come.
